mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market distress, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increasing, and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline and unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases, and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases and real GDP (GDPC1) also increases, it signals a strong supply-side economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO and GDPC1 both increase, and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
